# bioexcel/biobb_analysis/gmx_check

## Summary

Wrapper of the GROMACS check module for comparing and validating GROMACS files.

GROMACS check reads, analyzes and compares run input, trajectory and energy files reporting potential differences and inconsistencies.

Nextflow adapter of the [GMXCheck](https://biobb-analysis.readthedocs.io/en/latest/gromacs.html#module-gromacs.gmx_check) building block of [biobb_analysis](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_analysis) 5.3.0.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_ANALYSIS_GMX_CHECK } from 'bioexcel/biobb_analysis/gmx_check'

workflow {
    BIOBB_ANALYSIS_GMX_CHECK(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_structure_path` | no | tpr, gro, g96, pdb, brk, ent | Path to the first GROMACS run input file |
| `input_structure_2_path` | no | tpr, gro, g96, pdb, brk, ent | Path to the second GROMACS run input file |
| `input_traj_path` | no | xtc, trr, cpt, gro, g96, pdb, tng | Path to the first GROMACS trajectory file |
| `input_traj_2_path` | no | xtc, trr, cpt, gro, g96, pdb, tng | Path to the second GROMACS trajectory file |
| `input_energy_path` | no | edr | Path to the first GROMACS energy file |
| `input_energy_2_path` | no | edr | Path to the second GROMACS energy file |
| `structure_check_path` | no | tpr, gro, g96, pdb, brk, ent | Path to the structure file to analyze for internal consistency |
| `input_index_path` | no | ndx | Path to the GROMACS index file |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_log_path` | yes | txt, log, out | Path to the text file storing the gmx check console output |
| `versions_biobb_analysis` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_analysis', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of GMXCheck properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_log_path: 'txt']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_analysis container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_ANALYSIS_GMX_CHECK' {
        ext.properties = [vdwfac: 0.8]
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `vdwfac` | number | 0.8 | Fraction of the sum of Van der Waals radii used as warning cutoff. |
| `bonlo` | number | 0.4 | Minimum fraction of the sum of Van der Waals radii for bonded atoms. |
| `bonhi` | number | 0.7 | Maximum fraction of the sum of Van der Waals radii for bonded atoms. |
| `relative_tolerance` | number | 0.001 | Relative tolerance for comparing real values. |
| `absolute_tolerance` | number | 0.001 | Absolute tolerance, useful when sums are close to zero. |
| `rmsd` | boolean | false | Print RMSD for coordinates, velocities and forces. |
| `compare_ab` | boolean | false | Compare the A and B topologies from a single input file. |
| `last_energy_term` | string | null | Last energy term to compare. |
| `binary_path` | string | "gmx" | Path to the GROMACS executable binary. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
